name: Elandra Flowers
address: Al Siddique - Near United Hyper Market Parking, Abu Baker Al Siddique Road - Metro - Station - Hor Al Anz - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: At Elandra Flowers, we are proud to be known as the best flower shop in Dubai, offering fresh, elegant, and beautifully designed floral arrangements for every occasion. From romantic bouquets and luxury flower boxes to wedding flowers, event décor, and corporate arrangements, our expert florists create designs that reflect style and sophistication. We also provide indoor plants, succulents, and unique green gifts to brighten homes and offices. With reliable same-day flower delivery across Dubai and a commitment to quality and service, Elandra Flowers is your trusted destination for flowers that leave a lasting impression.

reviews.author: MOHAMEDOSMAN HASSANKARAR
reviews.text:
​I visited Al Indra (opposite United Hypermarket in Hor Al Anz) to get a birthday bouquet for my wife, and the experience was absolute perfection from start to finish.
​A huge thank you to Ms. Elena and Zahid for their warm and warmhearted welcome. They crafted a truly breathtaking bouquet, professionally designed to wrap around the gifts with astonishing, magical golden tones and accents. They customized everything precisely to my taste and stayed completely within my budget. The final result was elegant, unique, and far exceeded my expectations!
​If you are looking for stunning flowers and world-class customer service, this is definitely the place to go. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
I bought a bouquet of roses and sunflowers from Elantra Flower Shop and I’m very happy with my purchase. The flowers were fresh, vibrant, and beautifully arranged by the owner itself The roses looked elegant and fragrant, while the sunflowers added a bright and cheerful touch that really stood out.
The bouquet was well-balanced and thoughtfully designed, making it perfect for a love one or as a gift. You can really see the care and quality put into the flowers. I highly recommend Elantra Flower Shop if you’re looking for lovely, fresh flowers and great presentation.
